prompts.prompt: Create a visually rich ORIGINAL early-1990s graphic background for a LAiDIES Resident Card. Wide landscape 1680x936. Full bleed artwork, NO blank header band, NO card mockup or perspective. Direction DISCO AFTER DARK: glossy faceted mirror disco balls (perfectly spherical), a single elegantly drawn 90s pointed pump, round vinyl record, dimensional sparkle bursts, sweeping rhythm arcs. Build an intentional layered asymmetric composition with disco ball cropped top right, vinyl cropped lower left, pump near lower right, smaller stars at varied scales linking diagonally. Bold dark navy outlines, strong clean editorial ink, geometric faceted shading, controlled Ben-Day halftone. Adult, vivid, collectible, detailed retro printing, not children's clipart. NOT a bottom row of tiny icons and NOT a giant empty rectangle. Palette strictly deep INK #11183b dominant ground with saturated PURPLE #7137d6, HOT PINK #f254a9 and CYAN #15bce0 reflections; tiny CORAL #ff7366 only. No light pastel mixes, no cream/gold, no muddy plum. Let ink navy form breathing space through centre-left x12%-58% y25%-70%, with faint navy-on-navy large print texture so future resident text can overlay there. Graphic clusters occupy30%-40% of canvas around other areas; right-side portrait may overlay later. Each object drawn with natural unstretched proportions. NO text, letters, logos, people, faces, cassettes, grids, ruled lines, white sticker outlines, Memphis semicircles, uniform confetti tiling. Produce polished attractive background artwork, not a page layout.
